summary: Backend-only testing for extended GET /api/admin/analytics (iteration 3) covering new fields previous_period, previous_totals, deltas, and the exclude_admin query param. Created /app/backend/tests/test_analytics_v2.py with 16 focused tests: (1) shape - all new keys present with correct types and ISO dates; (2) previous_period alignment - prev_end == period.start-1day and prev_start exactly N months before period.start (day=1) verified for months=1,3,6,12 and default; (3) exclude_admin default false includes admin activities (admin's 2 seeded التدقيق entries visible, 'admin' present in by_employee); (4) exclude_admin=true filters by_employee (no admin), by_department (التدقيق contribution drops), and totals; (5) exclude_admin also filters previous_totals (admin activity inserted in prev window of months=1 is correctly excluded); (6) isolated seed (+1 admin +1 employee in current month) shows exclude_admin totals grew by exactly 1 vs default +2; (7) deltas formula: (cur-prev)/prev*100 rounded 1dp, null when both 0, 100.0 when prev=0 cur>0 - all verified against current/previous totals self-consistency; (8) seeded scenario with 3 employee activities current + 1 employee activity at month-3 confirms delta formula and seeded depts visible at months=3 with exclude_admin; (9) no '_id' string in response for params {6}, {6,exclude_admin=true}, {1,exclude_admin=false}, {24,exclude_admin=true}; (10) auth unchanged - 401/403 unauth, 403 non-admin. All 16/16 new tests PASS. Full regression 49/49 PASS (16 v2 + 14 v1 + 19 maintenance) in 12.4s.
critical_code_review_comments: shift_month + previous-window computation is correct: prev_start uses shift_month(cur_y,cur_m,-months) giving exactly N months before period.start; prev_end = start - 1 day. Verified for months=1,3,6,12.
pct() helper returns None when both 0 and 100.0 when previous=0 and current>0 - matches spec exactly.
exclude_admin uses set lookup against db.users where role='admin' and applies $nin filter on user_id to BOTH current and previous windows (base_query is spread into both queries). Correct.
All MongoDB queries project out _id (find(..., {'_id': 0})); no leakage confirmed by string search across 4 parameter combinations.
Pre-existing minor: deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') still in server.py (flagged iter 1) - not part of this iteration scope.
Bool query param parsing relies on FastAPI default coercion; tested with both 'true' and 'false' string values - works.
seed_data_creation: Module-scoped fixtures create TEST_anly_c employee + 6 activities: 2 admin (التدقيق current month), 3 employee (التخطيط x2 + الإعلام current month), 1 employee (التخطيط at month-3 for delta tests). Isolated test also briefly adds/deletes +1 admin +1 employee activity for current month and +1 admin activity at month-1 (prev window). All seed data and the employee are deleted via admin token in teardown. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Analytics v2 (previous_period, previous_totals, deltas, exclude_admin) fully verified on https://maintenance-crew-3.preview.emergentagent.com. Regression suites: /app/backend/tests/test_maintenance_api.py (19), test_analytics.py (14), test_analytics_v2.py (16). When frontend consumes new fields, ensure UI shows delta arrows/percentages correctly handling null (both-zero) and the special 100.0 (prev=0) case. The exclude_admin toggle should be a checkbox/switch on the analytics dashboard with testID e.g. 'analytics-exclude-admin-toggle'.
